description: Triggers one grounded blog-post draft for a product (Content Lab). Generated ONLY from the product's own Krawlup facts — profile, tracked prompts, tracked keywords, triaged mentions; never auto-published, the founder reviews and copies the markdown into their own blog. Angles: prompt-answer (answer a tracked AI question that does not cite the product yet — pass the exact prompt text as sourceRef), comparison (honest vs-post; topic names the rival, unverified rival claims stay neutral), mention-answer (answer a real community mention — pass the term as sourceRef), custom. The draft flips from generating to ready (or honestly failed) in the dashboard's Content tab within a few minutes. Requires a key with the rescan scope

sourceRef.description: The grounding anchor when one exists: the exact tracked prompt text or the watch term

topic.description: What the post is about, one line (e.g. "best lightweight alternative to Acme for solo founders")

name: generate_content_draft
